notes.title: Five brand new levels!
notes.content: [p]I've been working hard on bug fixes but it's time that you got some new levels to solve!  I've just completed levels 21-25.  Five brand new puzzles to tickle your brain and possibly make you angry.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567466/f6c01e342c531f447c0d7cdaee4d70e8ff66a829.png"][/img][/p][p]Let me know you thoughts and ideas on the [url="https://discord.gg/JMaa3jD8cX"]Sorter discord[/url].  Thank you for supporting a lone developer creating something I'm passionate about and learning as I go.  I hope you enjoy the challenges![/p]

notes.title: Save issue hot fix
notes.content: This patch should fix the issue where your game progress won’t save.

notes.title: Minor tweaks
notes.content: Added a build number to the loading screen and some minor text changes

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Unlinked the Quit and Save functions. So the game should now Quit as expected.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a Levels Unlocked glitch that would give access to all levels without completing them.

notes.title: Quick bug squash
notes.content: This is a tiny update to fix an anti-aliasing issue when looking through a transparent cube, as well as a bug fix for level 3 cube spawning.
